image_description: A close-up photograph of a common iguana (Iguana iguana) resting on a tree branch. The iguana is positioned in profile, facing left, with its head raised. The background consists of blurred green foliage, suggesting a natural or zoo habitat. The iguana's body is greyish-green with visible granular scales, a prominent dorsal crest of spines along its back, and a large subtympanic shield below the ear area. The limbs are muscular with visible claws gripping the branch.
